classified_object.notes: Championship-style events coupling physiological power to computational course state. Platform is noted narratively, not as a separate classified_object enum value in v0.1.

performance_agency.summary: Human power, pacing, and tactics determine race outcomes.

performance_interface.summary: Bicycle and smart trainer resistance form an embodied machine interface.

embodied_performance.summary: Bicycle and smart trainer resistance form an embodied machine interface. Migrated as Embodied Performance; demand types are provisional.

arena.summary: Computational course geometry (gradients, drafting, position) constrains performance.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Platform position, course state, power input, and event timing synchronize the race.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Trainer standardization, power-source rules, and sensor controls support equivalence.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Platform state and event officials jointly administer the race.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Each rider's local physical setup remains locally managed while contest governance is centralized.

sensing_tracking.summary: Power, cadence, and HR sensing; anti-cheat/data integrity critical.

measurement.summary: Power-derived virtual speed/position and race results.

comparability.summary: Explicit trainer standardization used because comparability is fragile.

outcome_openness.summary: Race outcomes emerge from performance under constraints.

consequence_structure.summary: World championship stakes and real physiological load.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Physical performance and computationally mediated course state are structurally interdependent.

human_limits_accessibility.note: Real load; different crash profile than road.

source_provisional_finding.summary: Best positive Spatial Athletic System candidate in the Sprint 2 sample.
